newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zellweger Luwa says 97 pct of options used.
newsitem.headline: Zellweger Luwa says 97 pct of options used.

text.p: Zellweger Luwa AG said more than 97 percent of the share options it issued in May 1995 had been exercised by the May 21, 1997 deadline.

It said shareholders exercised 669,660 of the 690,000 options issued so that 44,644 new shares had been issued. Its basic capital now stood at 46.1 million Swiss francs and its market capitalisation at 519.9 million as of yesterday.
Shareholders could exercise 15 options into one bearer share at a price of 1,050 francs. Shares were trading at 1,103 francs, down 25, at 1410 GMT.
